name: Update addon registry

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  update-registry:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout this repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download the release jar and hash it
        id: hash
        run: |
          curl -fsSL "${{ github.event.release.assets[0].browser_download_url }}" -o addon.jar
          echo "sha256=$(sha256sum addon.jar | cut -d' ' -f1)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Resolve the latest Cobalt release
        id: cobalt_release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          release=$(curl -fsSL \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
            -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
            https://api.github.com/repos/CobaltMod/Cobalt/releases/latest)

          tag=$(echo "$release" | jq -r '.tag_name')
          url=$(echo "$release" | jq -r '[.assets[] | select(.name | endswith(".jar")) | select(.name | test("sources|dev|javadoc") | not)][0].browser_download_url')

          if [ -z "$tag" ] || [ "$tag" = "null" ] || [ -z "$url" ] || [ "$url" = "null" ]; then
            echo "Could not resolve the Cobalt release or its jar"
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "tag=$tag" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "url=$url" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Download the Cobalt jar and hash it
        id: cobalt_hash
        run: |
          curl -fsSL "${{ steps.cobalt_release.outputs.url }}" -o cobalt.jar
          echo "sha256=$(sha256sum cobalt.jar | cut -d' ' -f1)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Checkout registry repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: EvilPiza/addon-registry
          token: ${{ secrets.REGISTRY_PUSH_TOKEN }}
          path: registry

      - name: Patch registry.json
        run: |
          jq --arg ver "${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}" \
             --arg hash "${{ steps.hash.outputs.sha256 }}" \
             --arg url "${{ github.event.release.assets[0].browser_download_url }}" \
             --arg cobaltVer "${{ steps.cobalt_release.outputs.tag }}" \
             --arg cobaltUrl "${{ steps.cobalt_release.outputs.url }}" \
             --arg cobaltHash "${{ steps.cobalt_hash.outputs.sha256 }}" \
             '(.addons[] | select(.id == "mightystore") | .latest) = {version: $ver, cobaltVersion: $cobaltVer, cobaltUrl: $cobaltUrl, cobaltSha256: $cobaltHash, downloadUrl: $url, sha256: $hash}' \
             registry/registry.json > registry/registry.tmp.json
          mv registry/registry.tmp.json registry/registry.json

      - name: Commit and push
        run: |
          cd registry
          git config user.name "release-bot"
          git config user.email "release-bot@users.noreply.github.com"
          git commit -am "Update mightystore to ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}"
          git push
